# CLI reference

Run `pcbtestkit <command> --help` for the same text. Without a pip install use `python3 -m pcbtestkit` with the repository (or the installed plugin folder) on `PYTHONPATH`. AI agents: start with `pcbtestkit guide`.

| Command | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `run` | full export |
| `analyze` | weak-point analysis only |
| `init` | write a pcbtestkit.json template next to the project |
| `api` | call one agent-API tool |
| `tools` | list agent tools (--brief) or export their definitions |
| `guide` | print the agent quick reference (cheapest way for an AI to use this CLI) |
| `classes` | technology-class systems: list, show, check a board, validate, template |
| `mcp` | run the MCP stdio server |

## `pcbtestkit run`

full export

```text
pcbtestkit run [-h] [--config CONFIG] [--probe-side {auto,bottom,top}]
                      [--fab {standard,advanced,conservative}] [--class-system CLASS_SYSTEM]
                      [--tech-class TECH_CLASS] [--check-class SYSTEM[:CLASS]] [--no-kicad]
                      [--json] [--out OUT] [--panel PANEL] [--outline {rect,outline}]
                      [--jig-parts JIG_PARTS] [--no-fixture] [--no-route] [--no-jig] [--no-runner]
                      [--no-visuals] [--video] [--video-fps VIDEO_FPS] [--video-stills] [-q]
                      project
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `project` | .kicad_pcb, .kicad_pro or project folder |
| `--config` | alternative pcbtestkit.json |
| `--probe-side` | (one of: auto, bottom, top) |
| `--fab` | (one of: standard, advanced, conservative) |
| `--class-system` | class system id (pcbtestkit classes list), default eurocircuits-2024 |
| `--tech-class` | class to order in that system, e.g. 6C, standard, 4-layer |
| `--check-class` | extra class check, repeatable, e.g. ipc-2221-voltage:B2 |
| `--no-kicad` | skip kicad-cli DRC/ERC |
| `--json` |  |
| `--out` | output folder (default <project>/production_test) |
| `--panel` | fixture sites, e.g. 2x2 |
| `--outline` | (one of: rect, outline) |
| `--jig-parts` | comma separated refs (default: all THT) |
| `--no-fixture` |  |
| `--no-route` | leave the fixture board unrouted (ratsnest only) |
| `--no-jig` |  |
| `--no-runner` |  |
| `--no-visuals` | skip the KiCad 3D renders in the guide |
| `--video` | also render the explainer video: real 3D animation rendered with KiCad (needs ffmpeg; several minutes) |
| `--video-fps` | frame rate of the video's motion shots (default 24) |
| `--video-stills` | quick video from stills only, without the 3D animation |
| `-q`, `--quiet` |  |

## `pcbtestkit analyze`

weak-point analysis only

```text
pcbtestkit analyze [-h] [--config CONFIG] [--probe-side {auto,bottom,top}]
                          [--fab {standard,advanced,conservative}] [--class-system CLASS_SYSTEM]
                          [--tech-class TECH_CLASS] [--check-class SYSTEM[:CLASS]] [--no-kicad]
                          [--json] [--strict]
                          project
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `project` | .kicad_pcb, .kicad_pro or project folder |
| `--config` | alternative pcbtestkit.json |
| `--probe-side` | (one of: auto, bottom, top) |
| `--fab` | (one of: standard, advanced, conservative) |
| `--class-system` | class system id (pcbtestkit classes list), default eurocircuits-2024 |
| `--tech-class` | class to order in that system, e.g. 6C, standard, 4-layer |
| `--check-class` | extra class check, repeatable, e.g. ipc-2221-voltage:B2 |
| `--no-kicad` | skip kicad-cli DRC/ERC |
| `--json` |  |
| `--strict` | exit 1 on critical findings (CI) |

## `pcbtestkit init`

```text

                       [--fab {standard,advanced,conservative}] [--class-system CLASS_SYSTEM]
                       [--tech-class TECH_CLASS] [--check-class SYSTEM[:CLASS]] [--no-kicad]
                       [--json] [--force]
                       project
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `project` | .kicad_pcb, .kicad_pro or project folder |
| `--config` | alternative pcbtestkit.json |
| `--probe-side` | (one of: auto, bottom, top) |
| `--fab` | (one of: standard, advanced, conservative) |
| `--class-system` | class system id (pcbtestkit classes list), default eurocircuits-2024 |
| `--tech-class` | class to order in that system, e.g. 6C, standard, 4-layer |
| `--check-class` | extra class check, repeatable, e.g. ipc-2221-voltage:B2 |
| `--no-kicad` | skip kicad-cli DRC/ERC |
| `--json` |  |
| `--force` |  |

## `pcbtestkit api`

call one agent-API tool

```text
pcbtestkit api [-h] [--project PROJECT] [--args ARGS] [--no-save] [--actor ACTOR]
                      [--compact]
                      tool
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `tool` |  |
| `--project` |  |
| `--args` | JSON arguments |
| `--no-save` | do not persist writes |
| `--actor` | name stored in the audit log (default: ai) |
| `--compact` |  |

## `pcbtestkit tools`

list agent tools (--brief) or export their definitions

```text
pcbtestkit tools [-h] [--format {mcp,anthropic,openai}] [--read-only]
                        [--profile {full,core,readonly}] [--brief] [--name NAME]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--format` | (one of: mcp, anthropic, openai; default: mcp) |
| `--read-only` |  |
| `--profile` | (one of: full, core, readonly; default: full) |
| `--brief` | one line per tool: name, R/W, summary |
| `--name` | print one tool's description and input schema |

## `pcbtestkit guide`

print the agent quick reference (cheapest way for an AI to use this CLI)

```text
pcbtestkit guide [-h]
```


## `pcbtestkit classes`

technology-class systems: list, show, check a board, validate, template

```text
pcbtestkit classes [-h] [--class CLS] [--system SYSTEM] [--target TARGET_CLASS]
                          [--config CONFIG] [--out OUT] [--json]
                          {list,show,check,validate,template,catalog} [target ...]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `action` | (one of: list, show, check, validate, template, catalog) |
| `target` | system id (show), project (check) or JSON files (validate) |
| `--class` | class to show (show) |
| `--system` | limit check to these systems (check) |
| `--target` | check compliance with this class of one --system (check) |
| `--config` | alternative pcbtestkit.json (check) |
| `--out` | output file (template) |
| `--json` |  |

## `pcbtestkit mcp`

run the MCP stdio server

```text
pcbtestkit mcp [-h] [--project PROJECT] [--read-only] [--profile {full,core,readonly}]
```

| Argument | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `--project` | board or project to open at start (open_project can switch later) |
| `--read-only` | refuse every write tool |
| `--profile` | tools to expose: full (31), core (16, about half the tokens), readonly (one of: full, core, readonly; default: full) |
